name: Tugna Default Category Image
author: Fatah At imisi Himene

sections.description:
Tugna Default Category Image is a lightweight plugin that makes it easy to assign a default image to categories in WordPress. If a post within a category does not have a featured image, the category’s default image will be used instead. This ensures a consistent look across your site and reduces the hassle of missing thumbnails.

Key Features

  • Assign a default image to any category.
  • Automatically applies the default image if a post doesn’t have a featured image.
  • Easy-to-use interface: Manage default images directly on the category edit screen.
  • Works seamlessly with WordPress themes and featured image functionality.
  • Admin page for plugin instructions and support links.

Use Cases

  • Perfect for blogs and news sites where every post requires a thumbnail.
  • Helps maintain visual consistency on category archive pages and widgets.

License

sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin zip file.
  2. Go to your WordPress dashboard, navigate to “Plugins > Add New” and click on “Upload Plugin.”
  3. Upload the zip file and click “Install Now.”
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. Navigate to “Tools > Tugna Default Image” for setup instructions.
sections.faq:
How do I set a default image for a category?

Go to “Posts > Categories,” edit a category, and enter the URL of the image you want to set as the default.

What happens if a post belongs to multiple categories with default images?

The default image from the first category (based on WordPress’s category order) will be used.

Can I use images from the WordPress Media Library as default images?

Yes! Simply copy the URL of an image in your Media Library and paste it into the default image field.

Does this plugin work with all themes?

The plugin is designed to work with any theme that uses WordPress’s built-in featured image functionality.

Is the plugin compatible with multisite?

Yes, it works on WordPress multisite installations.
